ensembles.name: Jazz Ensemble I
ensembles.description: The program’s flagship big band, and the group that carries our name at festivals and on record. It headlines both the fall and spring jazz festivals and anchors the annual album release.

ensembles.name: Jazz Ensemble II
ensembles.description: Our second big band, performing a full concert season of its own alongside the vocal ensembles. Many players move up through this group into Jazz Ensemble I.

ensembles.name: Contemporary Jazz Ensemble
ensembles.description: Focused on modern and contemporary jazz writing, including music by our own composition students.

ensembles.name: Latin Jazz Ensemble
ensembles.description: Afro-Cuban, Brazilian and Latin jazz repertoire. The ensemble has recorded five albums in the Latin Journey series, and recorded along with the Joe Williams Scholarship Quintet in the most recent album Back Home.

ensembles.name: Studio Scarlet Jazz Vocal Ensemble
ensembles.description: A vocal jazz ensemble performing both on campus and in the community, appearing regularly on our Clark County Library series.

ensembles.name: Maryland Parkway Jazz Vocal Ensemble
ensembles.description: A vocal jazz ensemble named for the street that runs alongside campus, sharing programs with our big bands and appearing on the annual Vocal Jazz Night.

ensembles.name: Joe Williams Scholarship Quintet
ensembles.description: A small group of scholarship students performing as a working jazz quintet, on campus and throughout Las Vegas.

ensembles.name: Joe Williams Scholarship Combo
ensembles.description: The second of our two Joe Williams Scholarship small groups, performing across the concert season.
